seedJustification: neither seed appears in any R10 arm directory or artifact

commonInitialWorld.rule: same seed -> same createWorldV2 state + same initial resources + same warehouse stock + same npc_07 location + same deterministic ids
commonInitialWorld.hash: d1-start.json.worldInitSha, identical for every arm of a seed

primaryMetric.numerator: commitment instances with >=1 authoritative receipt of the goal type, actor and place, within their own revision
primaryMetric.denominator: all commitment instances created in the game (initial + checkpoint/follow-up delegations)
primaryMetric.nullPolicy: if a game has 0 instances -> null (not 0)

opportunityRule.cancelHeard: an active instance at saveClock + 60 min
opportunityRule.cancelUnheard: a second active instance at saveClock + 60 min
opportunityRule.relay: the unheard instance still active at saveClock + 90 min
opportunityRule.change: an open alt-source change created by a real out_of_stock after the drain
opportunityRule.restock: the warehouse restock at saveClock + 240 min; exposure = the promisor witnessed it (location-scoped engine memory)
opportunityRule.contention: >=2 active deliver-meal instances when the warehouse is drained to 1

interferenceRule: absolute world minutes = saveClock + the frozen offsets {"cancelHeard":10,"cancelUnheard":10,"drain":20,"followUp":20,"relay":30,"rejectChange":40,"restock":60,"watch":480}; the save itself is at the first round >= D2 08:00 with >=1 active commitment and >=1 working intent bound to that instance and revision

checkpointDelegation.selection: least-fatigued idle promisor (stamina desc, hunger desc, id asc)

budgetNote: inherits the project 10 GPU-hour ledger; this freeze does not open a new pot
